title: Following exceptions to their handlers
description: You can track file and conversion errors through process, then watch cleanup during a failure.

steps.description: process reads a file, strips its text, converts it to an integer and doubles it. You can see that these functions let failures travel to their callers.
The first test prints 84. The next tests catch a missing file, an invalid integer and another missing file through their selected handlers.
The printed inheritance chains put ValueError and MemoryError under Exception. KeyboardInterrupt appears directly under BaseException, so the Exception handler above would leave it uncaught.

steps.question: Which message comes first after the operation raises: closed db_connection or caught: something went wrong?
steps.answer: closed db_connection comes first. The finally block calls close before the RuntimeError reaches the outer handler.

steps.description: You see opened db_connection, closed db_connection and then the caught error. The recorded failure still passes through the cleanup block.
